description: This file defines the AppendStream class, which is a read-only stream decorator that allows reading from multiple streams sequentially. It implements the Psr\Http\Message\StreamInterface and provides methods for managing multiple streams, reading, seeking, and obtaining stream metadata.

classes.name: AppendStream
classes.description: A read-only stream decorator that concatenates multiple streams for sequential reading.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an AppendStream instance with an optional array of streams to decorate.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire contents of the combined streams as a string, rewinding the streams first.

methods.name: addStream
methods.description: Adds a new stream to the list of streams to be read sequentially. Throws exception if the stream is not readable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Reads and returns the remaining contents of the stream.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all attached streams and resets internal pointers.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches all streams, resets pointers, and returns null.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current read/write position within the stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates the total size of all attached streams if possible; returns null if any stream size is unknown.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the combined streams has been reached.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the read position to the beginning of the combined streams.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Attempts to seek to a specific position within the combined streams; only supports SEEK_SET.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the current position across the concatenated streams.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream is readable (always returns true).

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream is not writable (always returns false).

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Returns whether the combined stream is seekable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Throws an exception since the stream is read-only.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns metadata for the stream; returns null or empty array based on key.
